title: Ensure resetAllData handles cabin images: delete and re-upload to Supabase storage
description:
## Problem
The `resetAllData` function in `src/features/dataReset/` may not properly handle cabin images in Supabase storage. Need to verify and implement:

## Requirements
1. **Audit current behavior**: Check if `resetAllData` currently uploads cabin images to Supabase storage
2. **Delete all images**: When resetting, delete ALL files in the `cabin-images` bucket before re-uploading
3. **Add bulk delete function**: Add a `deleteAllImagesFromBucket` function to `src/services/supabase/storage/images.ts`
4. **Re-upload images**: Upload the cabin images from the reset data to storage
5. **Update database URLs**: Ensure the cabin records in the database contain the correct public URLs of the newly uploaded images

## Files involved
- `src/features/dataReset/actions.ts` - Main reset function
- `src/features/dataReset/data/` - Source data for reset
- `src/services/supabase/storage/images.ts` - Storage service (needs bulk delete)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Calling `resetAllData` clears the `cabin-images` bucket completely
- [ ] All cabin images are re-uploaded to storage
- [ ] Cabin database records have correct, working image URLs
close_reason: All sub-tasks completed: listAllFilesInBucket, deleteAllFilesInBucket, uploadCabinImagesToStorage functions added, and resetAllData integrated with image reset functionality

title: Add listAllFilesInBucket function to storage service
description:
Add a function to src/services/supabase/storage/images.ts that lists all files in a given bucket. This is needed to know what files exist before deleting them.

## Implementation
- Add `listAllFilesInBucket` function that takes supabaseClient and bucket name
- Use supabase.storage.from(bucket).list() API
- Return array of file objects with their paths
- Handle pagination if bucket has many files
- Include proper error handling and logging

title: Add uploadCabinImagesToStorage function for data reset
description:
Create a function to upload the local cabin images to Supabase storage during data reset.

## Implementation
- Create function in src/features/dataReset/ that uploads images from data/cabins/ folder
- Read the local jpg files (cabin-001.jpg through cabin-008.jpg)
- Upload each to the cabin-images bucket with matching filenames
- Use upsert:true to overwrite if exists
- Return mapping of cabin names to their new public URLs
- Handle errors gracefully with logging

title: Integrate image reset into resetAllData function
description:
Modify the resetAllData function to handle cabin images properly.

## Implementation
1. After deleting cabins from DB, call deleteAllFilesInBucket for cabin-images bucket
2. Upload all cabin images using the new upload function
3. Get the returned public URLs
4. Update the cabin data to use the fresh URLs before inserting into DB
5. Ensure proper error handling - if image operations fail, the reset should report the error

## Files to modify
- src/features/dataReset/actions.ts

title: Add deleteAllFilesInBucket function to storage service
description:
Add a function to src/services/supabase/storage/images.ts that deletes ALL files in a given bucket.

## Implementation
- Add `deleteAllFilesInBucket` function that takes supabaseClient and bucket name
- First list all files using the new listAllFilesInBucket function
- Use supabase.storage.from(bucket).remove([paths]) to delete in batches
- Handle empty bucket case gracefully
- Include proper error handling and logging
- Return count of deleted files
